result.title: A differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology via linear interpolation
result.summary: Persistent homology can be differentiated and incorporated into learning pipelines, but no analogous framework exists for zigzag persistence, which is needed when the underlying topological structure evolves non-monotonically over time. We develop such a framework for sequences of simplicial complexes obtained by thresholding time-dependent filtering values on a fixed complex. By assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times at which linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, we transfer the continuity of the filtering values to the diagram points. This yields smooth local lifts of the resulting persistence-diagram-valued map, from which we derive differentials almost everywhere under mild regularity conditions on the parametrization of the filtering values. We prove local Lipschitz continuity outside an explicit measure-zero exclusion set; standard stochastic subgradient convergence guarantees therefore do not apply directly. We argue that, even without such guarantees, this exclusion set is small enough in practice to allow effective optimization. We test this empirically in two experiments: sensor network coverage optimization and dynamic graph classification.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文为 zigzag 持久同调建立可微框架：对固定复形上时变过滤值做阈值化，把持久图端点的取值时间定义成交叉阈值处，从而在温和正则条件下得到几乎处处的微分，并用传感器网络覆盖优化与动态图分类两个实验验证可优化性。
AI.relevance_reason: 非单调拓扑演化下的可微结构学习与 LVR 关心的 latent 表示随时间更新、状态是否平滑可训练有概念联系，其「伪梯度加零测集排除」的做法可能供核查 latent 状态训练中不可导或表征不稳定问题的处理。
